description: Defines the ocudu::sampling_rate class, which abstracts sampling rate concepts, including validation, conversion, and DFT size calculation, with integration for subcarrier spacing and custom formatting.

classes.name: sampling_rate
classes.description: Represents and manages sampling rate values, providing validation, unit conversion, DFT size calculation, and creation from different units.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the sampling rate is valid for a given subcarrier spacing in Hz or enumerator.

methods.name: get_dft_size
methods.description: Calculates the DFT size based on the sampling rate and subcarrier spacing.

methods.name: to_Hz
methods.description: Returns the sampling rate in Hertz.

methods.name: to_kHz
methods.description: Returns the sampling rate in Kilohertz.

methods.name: to_MHz
methods.description: Returns the sampling rate in Megahertz.

methods.name: from_Hz
methods.description: Creates a sampling_rate object from a value in Hertz.

methods.name: from_kHz
methods.description: Creates a sampling_rate object from a value in Kilohertz.

methods.name: from_MHz
methods.description: Creates a sampling_rate object from a value in Megahertz.
